svg.title: Algerian Current: published May 1986 coastal reach
svg.desc: Dated source-reported regional coastal reach strictly greater than 300km. No finite upper endpoint or numerical uncertainty reported. Not whole-current length or a geographic route; coast proximity is not width.

g.text: Strict reported threshold; no finite upper bound
30 km in the source describes proximity to the coast, not current width.
Whole-current length and seasonal ranges remain unmeasured.
Verified abstract and results pages; archive copy lacks printed pages 1596–1597.
Schematic constraint display; arrow is not geography or a traced current axis.
No confidence interval, whole-current rank, geometry or physical width inferred.
